notes: Fix: black picture with working sound. Some videos (phone and screen-recorder files, HEVC/H.265) cannot be shown by the browser. The app now notices and makes a small preview copy automatically (a progress message is shown); there is also a "Picture black or choppy? Make a preview copy" button in section 1. Only the preview uses the copy; After Effects and the transcription still use your original file.

Fix: transcription that seemed stuck at "4 %". The first transcription on a new computer downloads the speech model (about 1.6 GB); this is now shown with MB and percent (and a clear message if the download fails). Every step is named, with elapsed seconds, and also printed in the app's black window.
